subtitle: Cross-check of 15/Oct/2026, 11th day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, the thirteen national polls conducted after the vote, including Palver and Indexa of 15/Oct and [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 14 and 15/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 22.50% (cumulative volume USD 24.63M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, up 8.00pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 18:12 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT BOX: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 49% to 50% in Palver and 42% to 44% in Indexa of 15/Oct; ahead only in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, 44.2% to 42.7%.
fortes: He leads Vox Brasil of 09/Oct by 44.2% to 42.7%, within the margin of 2.15 points, and has 50.86% of the valid votes.
In Palver, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro narrows from 5 points in the 03/Oct wave to 1 in the 10 to 13/Oct wave, and in PoderData/Aya from 5 to 2 between the 05 to 07/Oct and 10 to 12/Oct waves.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 24.63M.
fracos: He stands at 22.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 54.75pp.

He trails in twelve of the thirteen national polls conducted after the vote: 49% to 50% in Palver and 42% to 44% in Indexa of 15/Oct, 44% to 46% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct, 46% to 48% in PoderData/Aya and 45% to 48% in BTG/Nexus of 13/Oct and 44% to 53% in Gerp of 12/Oct.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 22.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 24.63M), confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, and rises 8.00pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 18:12 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 In Palver of 15/Oct he has 49% against 50%, after 44% to 49% in the 03/Oct wave, and in Indexa he has 42% against 44%. [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct gave Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 44%; between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, PoderData/Aya gave 48% to 46%, BTG/Nexus 48% to 45%, Futura/100% Cidades 50% to 46.6% and Gerp 53% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. Lula is expected to go to Congress for the promulgation of the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule (O Globo and Metrópoles), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ On the night of 14/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, waived the 48-hour wait and the Exército do Lula channel came back on air (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Agência Brasil); on 15/Oct the full TSE unanimously struck down that wait for all channels registered after the deadline (G1, Estadão and Folha de S.Paulo). The same day the court overturned an injunction by Justice André Mendonça and ordered the removal of videos by the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira that link Lula to the alleged [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital and Estadão), and Flávio Bolsonaro asked the TSE to investigate unions and annul Lula's ticket (UOL and Poder360). Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça met with Meta on 15/Oct, after reports showed that WhatsApp's AI created campaign images for "Flávio 22" but not for "Lula 13" (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital and Gazeta do Povo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the schedule: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 77.25% (cumulative volume USD 20.75M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, down 7.75pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 18:12 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT BOX: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLL: 50% to 49% in Palver and 44% to 42% in Indexa of 15/Oct; ahead in twelve of the thirteen post-vote national polls.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 77.25% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT.

He leads twelve of the thirteen national polls conducted after the vote: 50% to 49% in Palver and 44% to 42% in Indexa of 15/Oct, 46% to 44% in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct, 48% to 46% in PoderData/Aya and 48% to 45% in BTG/Nexus of 13/Oct and 53% to 44% in Gerp of 12/Oct.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct, with 42.7% against 44.2%, and in Palver his lead narrows from 5 points to 1 between the 03/Oct and 10 to 13/Oct waves.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 77.25% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 20.75M), confirmed reading of 15/Oct, 17:37 BRT, and falls 7.75pp against the confirmed reading of 14/Oct at 18:12 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Two national polls came out on 15/Oct. Palver, with 5,000 interviews from 10 to 13/Oct, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 50% and Lula 49%, with 1% blank and null votes and no undecided voters; in the 03/Oct wave, on the eve of the first round, it was 49% and 44% (Poder360). Indexa, commissioned by Estadão/Broadcast, with 2,000 interviews on 13 and 14/Oct, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 44% to 42% in total votes and 51% to 49% in valid votes; in the 30/Sep wave it was 42% for him and 43% for Lula (Poder360 and Estadão). [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 14/Oct gave Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 44%; between the night of 12/Oct and 13/Oct, PoderData/Aya gave 48% to 46%, BTG/Nexus 48% to 45%, Futura/100% Cidades 50% to 46.6% and Gerp 53% to 44%, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%. 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1). Renan Santos said on 15/Oct that he sees a greater danger of concentration of power in a Flávio Bolsonaro victory, but that he does not back Lula and will not vote (O Globo and Estadão). On the night of 14/Oct, the Senate approved, by 75 votes to 1 in both rounds of voting, the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule, which cuts the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours; the only vote against was Hamilton Mourão's, and the text goes to promulgation, which Davi Alcolumbre points to for next week (Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital and G1). Flávio Bolsonaro had said on 13/Oct that he would vote in favour, and he will attend the Band debate on 18/Oct after having said he would not (UOL, CartaCapital and CNN Brasil). The Public Security PEC is on the Senate floor agenda on 15/Oct (G1 and O Globo). ⚖️ On the night of 14/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, waived the 48-hour wait and the Exército do Lula channel came back on air (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Agência Brasil); on 15/Oct the full TSE unanimously struck down that wait for all channels registered after the deadline (G1, Estadão and Folha de S.Paulo). The same day the court overturned an injunction by Justice André Mendonça and ordered the removal of videos by the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira that link Lula to the alleged [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital and Estadão), and Flávio Bolsonaro asked the TSE to investigate unions and annul Lula's ticket (UOL and Poder360). Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça met with Meta on 15/Oct, after reports showed that WhatsApp's AI created campaign images for "Flávio 22" but not for "Lula 13" (Folha de S.Paulo, CartaCapital and Gazeta do Povo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).
